notes.title: Build Update #9: 1.1.41
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

It’s been a while—and we truly appreciate your patience and continued support during our time away. While it’s been over a year since our last update, we’ve been quietly working behind the scenes, and we’re excited to finally bring you a fresh patch packed with meaningful improvements and some exciting new additions to enhance your journey.

Your feedback and bug reports have remained invaluable throughout development, and this update is a direct result of your passion and insights.

New Features:

 Whirlwind Attack Enhancement: All upgraded Hibino armors now feature new ranged unique-elemental attacks when using the Whirlwind skill.
 Fast Travel System: Introducing Hermes Express—a new, streamlined way to traverse Talos Castle more efficiently.
 Expanded Exploration: New rooms have been added, and the map has been rearranged to encourage deeper exploration.
 Boss Battle Quality of Life: Boss introductions have been shortened when replaying encounters.
 Radical Acceptance for final chapter: This ability will now persist after acquiring the last armor.
 Auriel Blast: The Auriel Blast ability now activates instantly—no charge time required.

Bug Fixes:

 Resolved an issue where enemies defeated with Apino’s projectiles weren’t being registered in the Bestiary.
 Fixed button rebinding issues that were affecting gameplay.

Balance Adjustments:

 Combo Integration: Strong Attacks now deal significantly more damage when used as part of a combo.
 Elemental Synergy: Attacks that align with an enemy’s elemental weakness (based on equipped armor) now inflict increased damage.
 Armor Boosts: Equipping upgraded armors now enhances Europa’s base attack power.

We’re thrilled to finally reconnect with you, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the changes. Whether you have feedback, a bug to report, or simply want to hang out with fellow players and the dev team, our Discord is the place to be. Your enthusiasm continues to shape the world we’re building together!

notes.title: Build Update #8: 1.0.98
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

As we kick off 2024, we want to express our sincere gratitude for your ongoing support and feedback. Over the past few months, we've diligently reviewed your reports, and we're thrilled to share the latest enhancements we've made to elevate your gaming experience.

Here are the key highlights:

New Features:

 Auto-save now triggers after defeating any mid-boss or final boss.

Bug Fixes:


 Resolved an issue where "Next dialogue" or "Skip dialogue" inputs weren't functioning correctly.
 Addressed a controller settings bug affecting hierarchy-based inputs, such as the dialogue system.
 Fixed a texture issue with the VFX on the strong attack of the Helios Upgraded armor.
 Rectified a texture problem with the central projectile in the Gear of Erebus battle.
 [Solved a bug where fire bullets failed to explode from the Vlastor Pyro.
 Corrected an enemy placement issue in the Portrait of Demise that caused coins to become stuck in a Gaia tunnel.
 Eliminated a bug that automatically skipped the prologue's first elevator dialogue.
 Fixed an issue causing some Steam achievements not to unlock as intended.

Changes:

 Enjoy a fresh set of sound effects for the Logon Duck's spinning razor attack.
 Witness art improvements across various rooms in all areas.


For those eager to connect with our development team, report issues, or engage with our community, please join our Discord channel. Your continued support fuels our commitment to delivering the best gaming experience possible.

And today, we have additional great news! 
We're being featured in a Metroidvania Souls-like bundle on Steam! Go check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38214/Metroidvania_SoulsLike_Bundle/


Thank you for being part of our journey!

notes.title: Build Update #4: Performance and Optimization
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope you're all doing well. It's been a month since our last update, where we shared that we have been working on some performance fixes and optimizing general assets throughout the game.

We thank you for your patience and empathy while we work on new fixes and ways to make the game feel better. 

If you want to talk with our dev team, report an issue, or join the community, please join our Discord! We'd love to hear from you all!

Bug fixes:
Game Balance Adjustments

 A new visual aid for the light bar has been added when Europa is performing Lullaby or Radical Acceptance.
 Radical Acceptance "sweet spot" is now always positioned in the middle of the recovery bar.
 Radical Acceptance now recovers less light if it is used immediately consecutively.
 The shield recovery speed values have been adjusted for the final armor set.
 Health and damage values have been rebalanced and adjusted for all bosses, mid-bosses, and enemies.
 The Final Battle and Logon Duck boss fights have been rebalanced based on changes to health recovery mechanics.
 The Hekate's Illusion boss has a new attack.

Visual Updates

 Painting portals have been updated.
 Incorrect elevator cinematic animations have been fixed.
 Fixes for some of the art assets in the Theater / Workshop.

Bug Fixes

 "Falling Stars" attack in the final battle has had a crash bug fixed.
 A crash bug related to particles spawning on heat currents has been fixed.
 A bug causing the shield recovery bar to appear while Europa has the final armor upgrade has been fixed.
 A fix has been applied to ensure the Tantalus Roach boss arena door opens consistently.
 A fix has been applied to prevent the Heart of Talos from spawning a shield effect during battle.
 The music looping bug in the painting area of Sector E has been fixed.
 The animation delay when saving the game has been corrected.

Performance Enhancements

 Enemy sprite sheets had compression improvements.
 Object Pooling has been enhanced to reduce lag by pre-loading common objects (such as attack slashes).
 Reduced build size on disk by 6.2 GB thanks to optimizing files, sprite sheets, textures, and materials.

notes.title: Update #42: Improving Performance
notes.notes:
Hello everyone; we hope you’re all doing well! Summer is fast approaching, and with it, we want to address our focus to improve the game’s performance.

If you played 9 Years of Shadows recently, you’ve noticed we uploaded a localization patch, which includes French, German, Russian, Portuguese, Chinese, and Japanese as available languages. 

We also uploaded several bug fixes across the different patches, most of which solved technical issues due to game optimization. We have been fixing another batch of various bugs and performance issues and are now in a testing phase to check that everything is in order. 

However, we know that some of you have encountered crashes in certain areas, so we wanted to reassure you of our commitment to solving them and working on solutions to prevent future crashes from happening again. 

We thank everyone who has taken the time to report their problems and continue supporting us as we work towards making the game smoother with each patch. 

The following are the main improvements of the past few weeks that will be present in an upcoming patch: 


 Fixed bug RAM issue that was causing some players to encounter problems due to memory leak
 Improved the loading system to be more efficient with big textures and assets
 Compressed the executable size of the game to reduce space
 Improved performance in intensive areas and battles in the game
 Improved texture sizes to reduce spike lags

notes.title: Build Update #3: New languages
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope you’re all doing well. It’s been a month since our release day, and we
could not feel more grateful for everyone’s support, patience, and feedback. We appreciate you
taking the time to report bugs, suggest new elements that could improve the experience, and
read your comments on what 9 Years of Shadows has been for you.

In fact, because we’ve seen many people in different countries willing to play a game that wasn’t
localized in their language, we wanted to get Europa’s story to as many people as possible.
That’s why we worked with a localization team for 9YoS to be accessible in German, French,
Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, and Chinese, as well as making adjustments in Spanish and
English.

We hope this makes the journey more appealing for our community and that everyone can
travel alongside Apino.

Furthermore, we have been fixing many reported bugs that affected the overall gameplay. There

notes.title: Update #41 : We're Live!!

Hello everyone! The day has finally come! 9 Years of Shadows has officially launched on Steam!

We cannot stress enough what every single one of you means to the Halberd team; thanks to your belief in us when we had only started with a small team and a big dream, we managed to come this far, and it showed us what the power of community could do. After launch, we plan on releasing additional levels and new game+ as DLC, and we’ll keep you updated on the concrete dates as we continue with the development. Stay tuned to delve further into the world of 9 Years of Shadows!

The Halberd Team

notes.title: Dev Update #13: A Final Request
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you’re doing well and starting the holiday season in high spirits. With the launch date rapidly approaching, we wanted to craft this update a little bit differently.

Our current state

As the game's development progressed, the whole team put their heart and soul into the project, dedicating the entire week and weekends to meet deliveries and fix bugs, often giving up rest for the sake of the game. After people from all over the world tried the 9 Years of Shadows demo on Steam Next Fest, we gathered valuable feedback and noticed relevant issues that need to be addressed as soon as possible but that aren’t easy to solve.

If you have followed our journey closely, you’ll know that we are committed to delivering a worthy product, and while we know no game is perfect, we are confident we can do better. Our publisher has been very understanding of our situation and has supported our choice to regroup, take care of the team, and handle any lack of resources that due to our pipeline.

Release date

It is with a heavy heart that we have decided to delay the launch of our game a few months into 2023. This is an announcement we do not make lightly.

Our loyal community has been a driving force for every member of Halberd Studios, and delaying the game again is something that pains us greatly. However, in order for us to continue, we must ensure the well-being of the devs and reassess how we will approach the obstacles ahead. Rest assured that this is the last time we will resort to a delay, and are determined to finally release the game as promised.

We also want to reassure you that 9 Years of Shadows’s content and features are virtually finished, and the additional time we will take is going to be focused directly on polishing.

In fact, we would love to share a couple of things that have been in the works for a while. Firstly, take a look at the preview of Master Hibino's song, The Serpent Prince. If you have been enjoying Bayonetta 3's soundtrack, his collaboration in 9 Years of Shadows is just for you.

Also, we wanted to share a glimpse of an interesting area. What do you think this is?  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/555a907c0b5325e67a8a19aa3e1e1778f1c108ac.png

To our loving community

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/de977343cae681934aa6a6c4fe2802b72cc94377.png

From all of us, we earnestly thank you for the lasting support and good wishes for these past couple of years. There is nothing more we could ask of this wonderful community but to hang in there just for a little longer. In the end, it all comes down to a matter of time, and with it, we know your patience will be worth the wait.

As always, we will keep you posted on our progress with regular updates and through our social media, so make sure you follow us to stay in the loop

In genuine appreciation,
The Halberd Team

notes.title: Dev Update #12 - The Last Stretch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope you are starting this fall just as thrilled as we are. September marks the official beginning of Q4 of this year and the official launch for 9 Years of Shadows as well. The team has worked tirelessly to polish the remaining elements and ensure we are ready to welcome all of you into Talos Castle.

A month ago, we entered the QA phase, which is when we take care of details and perform the finishing touches before launch day. We noticed that the area we liked to focus our efforts on is the improvement of the experience of the game, which is the final leg of the race.

Because of this, we reconvened with our publisher and together decided that the best course of action to release the game the way we intend to, would be to reschedule our launch date to November 14th, 2022. We understand that this is not the ideal news for our community, and we apologize for the inconvenience it may represent to you.

Everyone on the team is eager to share this project with you and has been working relentlessly. We are confident that these additional few weeks will make a difference in the performance and ultimately represent a better experience for you.

We know the community is excited about the release, so we want to give you something to look forward to. We will be featured in Steam Next Fest, which takes place between October 3rd and 10th, so make sure you don’t miss out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/a1ee18ec5ae7eed72eb9326903ac0cc51d4f5959.png

As always, we appreciate your enormous support and love, and we are convinced that when 9 Years of Shadows is released in a few weeks, everything will be worth this extra effort.

- The Halberd Team

notes.title: Dev Update #11: The Reveal
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We truly hope everyone is doing well and excited in this gamer month! It’s well known that this month is full of amazing news, conferences, contests and big reveals, and, as part of this wonderful community, we simply couldn’t stay behind. Everyone who has followed the progress of 9 Years of Shadows is aware of the long and emotional journey the dev team has gone through, and you have all been there with us as we near the end of the race. Therefore, it is only fitting that we finally reveal what you have been asking for a while: the official release date!
If you caught us in gamescom2022earlier today, you probably watched our latest trailer where
we announced the Steam launch to be on October 10th!. If you missed the trailer or want to
watch it again, you can take a look at it here:

As you know, we always want to deliver the best possible result, which is why we feel taking that extra time is the best decision at the moment.

We are truly excited to show you something we have been working on lately. You may have seen one of our backer-enemies Limo in previous updates, but it feels fitting to show you more of the foes Europa can encounter inside Talos. notes.title: Dev Update #8: Creatures of the Deep
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you are doing well. As we begin the second quarter of the year, we have exciting news we have wanted to share with you for a while.

Summer always marks the beginning of amazing gaming events, and this year it’s no different. 9 Years of Shadows will be featured in Guerrilla Collective on June 11th, a digital game showcase with developers worldwide. Make sure you catch that on Twitch or YouTube. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/6e5b0d2ca5d4094195f4e12b39c4579c96bf06d0.jpg

Furthermore, we will also appear in IGN’s Summer of Gaming on June 10th, which our team is very excited about. You can also check it out on Twitch, YouTube, or their own website. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/08e144580cfe98a1c5ff002da17b708a5b56016b.jpg

If you have been following our social media, you might have noticed various rooms from Talos Castle have been featured. One of the most prominent ones is our underground water ecosystem, a massive area submerged into the depths of the giant and covered in age-old vegetation. The original civilizations who inhabited Talos Castle sought to build their empire with the resources at their disposal; while some favored fire and earth, others preferred the peacefulness of water.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/6622705d114bb53e14127864b465a56dd640b6a5.png

Now, all that remains are deep-buried vestiges of their culture, ready to be discovered by the adventurous or the curious. When Europa visits this part of the castle, she may need to fight past powerful currents to uncover their remnants.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/39fa5871c33c2bf1576b6e6959185363ad19d973.png

But as you know, for every beauty inside Talos, there is danger lurking about. With a varied assortment of enemies, hidden bosses await for the unwary to stumble upon their lair and strike. Just take a look at the nightmare that is the Tantalous Roach, a massive insect whose eyes would follow you everywhere you go.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/b86f232f62cea4e0f60a203e66063d4989b15176.png

For more terrifying creatures and extraordinary characters, be sure to consult our Bestiary! We will regularly reveal new beasts through our socials, so be sure to follow and take a look whenever you can! If you missed our post from a few days ago, take a look at Limo, a powerful slime mage from one of our dear backers. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/c9d9e8432278d5757de80db29a43d203038afb50.jpg

Thank you as always for your support and be ready for an amazing update coming soon!

The Halberd Team

notes.title: Dev Update #7 - A Trip Down Memory Lane
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope you had a nice Easter holiday for those of you who celebrate it. As you are aware, we enjoy sharing our progress with you in terms of the building of 9 Years of Shadows through our monthly updates.
This time, we would like to introduce you to some characters that set the tone for the game’s story. Meet Bebel and Wynton, two a mystic bassist and a nostalgic trumpeter that once belonged to a famous orchestra before finding themselves inside Talos Castle. With talented hands and a penchant for rhythm, musicians merge their craft in a beautiful symphony.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/094bf7a080e78f336ac79e1e2f0e27d93b951f89.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/57d0354197b9bf1529d84544dae7d4e9a2e1b92d.gif

As for other iconic characters, we have been talking about one in particular for the past couple of updates, the mysterious warrior Draythus. You have seen his portrait, but what do you think of his latest idle?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/4cbd95810e0a131dd8f6e1c9cb4b158648957f20.gif

And last, but certainly not least, take a look at the portrait of this noble couple. Though wealthy and well-respected, deadly diseases spear no one, regardless of their station. As a result, this portrait is one of the only reminders their daughter has of her parents, along with her halberd and a beautiful dress.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/637d5590d4f59a199ce5f7a16070ea08989fd5a5.jpg

Fueled by the powerful memory those heirlooms represent, Europa is ready to face anything. If you want to know more about the foes Europa will have to face, you might want to stay tuned tuned to our socials. As of this week, we will officially launch our Bestiary, a compilation of Talos’ most dangerous and intriguing creatures.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/27d837a9eb4c06ced05ba384051655e5ae16c55f.png

In fact, the most important creatures featured in the Bestiary are backer-enemies, interesting characters backers of a certain tier created, and we have decided to upgrade them to a boss category. When you run into NPCs such as Bebel and Wynton, they will have quests that may steer you in the direction of these terrifying foes.

Thank you for your everlasting support, as always! We will have exciting news soon, so make sure you follow us and join the conversation.
- The Halberd Team

notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you are doing great! This year is just beginning, but we are already swamped with work in all of our departments, making sure everything is falling into place. Therefore, we wish to share our current progress with you so you can see what we have recently been up to.

notes.title: Dev Update #4 - New Beginnings
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We wish you all a fantastic start of 2022, a year that certainly has our team beyond excited.  As you know from previous updates, we’re tirelessly working on bringing the world of 9 Years of Shadows to life!

This entails going through several tests, overseeing performance issues and placing the littlest of details into place, so definitely be on the lookout for more updates both here and on our social media.

You might have noticed that we have been quiet on YouTube lately, but that will change in the following months. If you recall, during our Kickstarter campaign we created Dev Diaries, a series of videos outlining Europa’s story, a couple of our key team players and even a special message from Michiru Yamane herself. This year, we’ll release our biggest Dev Diary yet, featuring topics like the soundtrack, the story, and most importantly, the gameplay. We always upload them to our Youtube channel, so be sure to be on the lookout for it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/98cb447950dc38a7b83c0c9bcb26d9f42f0d9005.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/d1f265c0ddf8e48b01e2b542469c7ad052ce2c29.png

Now that we are on the topic of story and gameplay, it seems only fitting that we introduce one of the game’s main bosses that is also heavily involved with the narrative. Meet Draythus, a legendary warrior. He is both elegant and dangerous, and his encounter with Europa is a pivotal moment for both of them and the story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/dd3fd4f0200e5941dbfe3193fa307a6933dc462d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/0feb3fc933b059f92a5365acfe5ad27cbea2f3f7.png

This ageless enemy, created by our awesome backer Maximilian Lee Carbaugh, as well as most of our other NPCs, has his own track whenever a conversation with him sparks up. Music often can tell more about a person than words; what do you make of Draythus’ theme?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/d90159187dc54ab32b9fd3f70bc73ec8ff344dc7.png

We have also been working on concept art for different sections of the castle. For instance, vegetation is looking better and more interesting each day. Take a look at various plants from our underwater landscape, greenhouse and boiler section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/54f3622bbf8fb318803d84db07979d99d21db1e3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/e97ab24afadc5b0234bae1aa5772302464bed1ef.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/cb3c7811add928cd039a8c68a4f1bceb2f172a3c.png

As every detail helps build the mystical atmosphere one breaths within Talos Castle, we have designed breakable elements that match each room Europa explores. Where do you think these items go?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/5b9b1be5ce2c3f800ecefadb24c6b17d8414ff02.png

Naturally, Europa has also been a character our team has heavily focused on, from emotional portraits to concept art. Every day, Europa is shaping up to become a deeply layered and interesting warrior maiden, and concepts like these allow us to understand her and the lore surrounding her much better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/e628a8b24b99e8447868a1fe0dfd6cef766729a7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/d7648f3b3de9a1a537503388c796a5bfc6cbc7e5.png

And it wouldn’t be 9 Years of Shadows without an update regarding our resident cuddly companion, Apino. Animating him is surely one of our favorite activities, just take a look at these poses!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/57a4c10292e4215d9001fb6b4ae4d7b1d6b3430a.gif

Lastly, we would like to say we feel extremely grateful for all your support and understanding last year, and for the faith you have placed in our team this year to finish the development of Europa’s story and welcome you to enjoy it. The journey is not yet over, but our resolve and motivation are stronger than ever, and together, we know we will see this through!

Remember to follow us on social media and stay tuned for upcoming news on the game!

notes.title: Dev Update #3 - Release Window, Cinematics and More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The year might be coming to an end, but we certainly haven’t stopped working on making the world of 9 Years of Shadows a place you will thoroughly enjoy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/18d94dd388916c59445cd9e1ee64371e4b2e504e.gif
We’ve kept busy with the polishing of our pixel art, improving how the controller feels and creating new cinematics for the game, among other developments. As a result, our publisher, Freedom Games, has recommended we delay the release of the game for some time. With a full-fledged game, we know we can take Europa’s story exactly where we want it to be and now expect to be able to share it with you in late 2022.

We want to sincerely thank you for your support, understanding and good wishes thus far! We know a delay of the release window is far from ideal, but we also know more time will allow us to polish the little details and, more importantly, deliver the game you deserve.

We know we’ve come a long way since our Kickstarter campaign and still have a way to go, but none of it would have been possible if not for your faith in the project and valuable feedback throughout the development process.

In fact, due to your comments on our enemy design and animation, we’ve come up with very interesting characters! Take a look at some of our enemies so far!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/3b8bbfbbfc007d76921f2487f2573faade392703.png
Art has actually been one of our primary focuses these past few months, not only architecture and special paintings, but cinematic cutscenes and conversational pieces as well. Here is Europa’s normal conversation portrait.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/fa7b963b533bb1944ea6216a68e3412b3b43d050.png
One of our other main focuses has been the creation of the soundtracks for the game. As you know, music plays a pivotal role in the overall narrative, gameplay and ambiance of 9 Years of Shadows, which means working on tracks always gets us excited! What do you think of our latest piece?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/8f5fa4e57b01600ff95e8b1408de365fd485442e.jpg
You might also recall we’re shooting a documentary of our game developing journey! Get a glimpse of the team’s insights on this exclusive sneak peek:
[previewyoutube=k6e_uh5WJAI;full][/previewyoutube]
If you paid attention to the teaser, you probably noticed one of the cinematics we have been working on as of late.  Take a closer look at a badass Europa and a cute-looking Apino inside a peculiar elevator.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/907e0a99050f03355fcb827cdb4ada8bd0be65e9.gif
If that left you curious and you want to get to know our developers on a more personal level, don’t forget to join our Discord server, where we’ll start having frequent chat sessions with the Halberd team and our community!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/d4900104a6a9d8c0f04de58dbc7014e6ff06315b.png
We’ll also return to more frequent updates on our Dev Diaries, so make sure you’re subscribed to our YouTube channel and turn on notifications!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/3f9e66fd96b734c95c00def630f90f3f86b79c59.png
Remember to follow us on social media to stay updated on our progress!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/813535a6fd661796062c26376f0fd90fc42c3461.png

Once again, we’re thankful you’ve joined us in this journey and remained by our side as we flesh out Europa’s story and set up an adventure that is both immersive and meaningful for all of you. Let us know what you think in the comments and if you have any questions, we’ll be happy to answer them and put your mind at ease.
We’ll be sharing more news with you soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/994b6d17c21b7bbbea365eb59b4ff66ca7fd3d2b.png
Hello everyone!

We’d like to begin Q4 of this year by keeping you posted on our latest developments. Our team has poured mind and heart into the new cinematics for the game. We are very fortunate to work with an excellent artist who leaves us speechless on how the shots look. We’ll be sharing glimpses of them in upcoming updates and can’t wait for you to be as astonished as we are.

In the meantime, we’d like to talk about environment art. In these past couple of months, our art department has been working on different special rooms within Talos Castle. One of them being the Room of Baptism, where Europa acquires the Poseidon armor. Check it out:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/114372a566e394507a3a157e1e54aac583a6c835.png

As you can tell, our concept design references many mythological elements and fantastic creatures that have also inspired several enemies. As an example, take a look at this concept art!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/925fa0717436c4d89a8428d79614927a0296d8e1.png

Speaking of enemies, all creatures within the castle are a blend of biological and mechanical parts, which makes for very unique enemies in Europa’s way. Meet the Elemental Tower, a foe with spinning shields and a spooky smile:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/38f7df09ef7c9ef617c509fca18abd5c21e61470.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/1dd5c53b3dad9d743f60b59e01e14f54609d6b87.gif

Finally, we have started to build the final feeling of combat regarding the enemies. Here is an example of how it looks so far:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/f9709d59974b07c6048784f4b7c26d9beb9d78b6.gif

We have some exciting news coming down this quarter, so be sure to stay tuned to our social media. This week we will send the backer surveys, so keep an eye on your email.
Thanks for all the constant support!

notes.title: Dev Update #1 - Elemental Combat
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/287cbda2e99221a5759c254c114e5156d94bd6b2.png
Hello everyone!
As we near the end of Q3 of our development, we have wonderful news we’ve been dying to share with our amazing community.

As you may know, we’ve recently changed our pixel art to pixel perfect, which means a huge performance improvement for the game. That also means we upgraded Europa’s run and combo animations to fit this new style. Keep in mind your attack variations! Alternating between light and heavy attacks can knock an enemy off balance, and if you use a heavy attack as a finisher, it’ll become stronger!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/c1429f798352fdcf284acceea63c529950a312e3.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/57f32de3ab60b318a30f96ef525d39cb2ed9f539.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/31373b910bfff34c507753812343a3f4c8fc5563.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/bc864043333c34931661723fbb1fc0769bdbee74.gif

But these are more than just combos; Europa’s elemental abilities are vital to progressing the game, as they unlock special areas and are also designed to battle specific enemies. For instance, enemies like these can only be destroyed through lightning, fire, water and earth respectively.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/b9ed508fc1ea0b81659bef6fce4e737582f90a1e.png

Speaking of enemies, we have also been working on some of the backer enemy designs you guys came up with! Now, Talos Castle is full of lore-infused characters that will make the story that much more interesting - and challenging as well!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/6d045df15b95310f75a0928e316d0eb2934750e4.gif

Keeping the diverse elemental advantages and disadvantages in mind will be crucial to interact with your surroundings and be ready for combat at the same time, especially knowing how to switch between them to make the most out of Europa’s powers.

And we couldn’t have an update without some gorgeous art pieces from a couple of Talos’ areas; here’s a glimpse of the castle’s entrance and the water area, where Europa's journey will take many twists and turns!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/00fb4cf3ae15386cac07aefce560e2299b401a53.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/acf1bbc630075726c61f929a8a6adceb0c76df77.png

Speaking of twists, there’s nothing that gives us bigger goosebumps than the newest fire area track. You can feel just how the stakes get higher for Europa and Apino as they venture into this blazing labyrinth while time is ticking. Check it out! 

Tracks like this get us extremely excited, especially knowing we’ll be working with talents of Manami Matsumae, Michiru Yamane and Norihiko Hibino’s caliber! Do you like what their characters look like in-game?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/aa9bf64bd06055f71066f4ae678e8a1bcf8d0ba9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/14baefe2096faaf1ce76f283d91d590827d5620b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/c13af91374724116620cec58af7ba692e0254393.png

Lastly, make sure you’re on the lookout for Future Games Show, Gamescom edition this Thursday, and tune in during the event for a special treat!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/5dba3a910b64fb7be28ad82131316e23ba73903f.png

If you’re as thrilled about Europa’s adventure as we are, don’t forget to wishlist 9 Years of Shadows! You can also join our Discord where you can talk with other fans. 

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!

The Halberd Team
